title: DOOM Eternal
synopsis: id Software’s sequel to DOOM (2016) — retained as Limited Run Games’ #154 Nintendo Switch physical edition.

catalog.developer: id Software · Nintendo Switch port by Panic Button
catalog.publisher: Bethesda Softworks · physical edition by Limited Run Games
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · Limited Run Games edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case · Limited Run Games #154 edition

curatorNotes:
DOOM Eternal follows the Doom Slayer to an Earth overrun by Hell, adding a dash, a shoulder-mounted flamethrower, and a wrist blade to the 2016 game’s combat. It released on March 20, 2020.

Panic Button’s Nintendo Switch version was digital-only at launch on December 8, 2020, adding gyro aiming. Limited Run Games produced its physical edition as Switch Limited Run #154, taking pre-orders in 2022.

The filing follows DOOM (2016) in the DOOM lineage.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Switch Limited Run #154, Limited Run Games’ standard physical edition of DOOM Eternal, with a reversible cover.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. The base campaign is on the card; The Ancient Gods expansions are paid downloads, and later updates and online content depend on Nintendo’s servers.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released March 20, 2020 on PC, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One; Nintendo Switch eShop December 8, 2020. Limited Run Games issued the physical edition (HAC-P-A6SVA) as Switch Limited Run #154 in standard, SteelBook, Special, and Ultimate editions.
preservation.availability: Limited Run Games’s physical edition was a limited production and now circulates through the secondary market. The digital Switch edition was issued separately on the Nintendo eShop.
